target_text: // The dense predicate (why a VNNI slot is excluded: see the file header).
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

"a full page of a row-major slot" restates the two operands on line 171 (n_tokens == book_t::page_size and !k_vnni::layout_on<head_size>), and "the kernels run only for" is what the REQUIREs on lines 195-196 already say. "a VNNI slot takes the software loop" repeats the file header's own sentence (lines 11-13, which call the same thing the AVX reader), so only the pointer to the header earns its place: the header holds the why (apply_page_tok compiles the dense path out for a VNNI slot), which the names do not.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // The dense predicate (why a VNNI slot is excluded: see the file header).
```
